parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to separately query the lowest prices for Y (economy) and C (business) cabins. Default value: FALSE.
> Specifies whether to separately query the lowest prices for Y (economy) and C (business) cabins. Default value: FALSE.
> - Normal case: Set to FALSE. The "item_list" returns only one item, which is the same as "best_price_item". You can use either one.
> - Special case: When set to TRUE, multiple prices are returned in the flight list. The "item_list" may return two items, and "best_price_item" is the lowest-priced item in "item_list" (not recommended).
parameters.description_zh:
是否分别查询出Y经济舱和C公务舱的最低价 默认-FALSE
> 是否分别查询出Y经济舱和C公务舱的最低价, 默认-FALSE
> - 正常情况：默认FALSE即可；返回结果中“item_ist-商品列表”只返回一个 和 “best_price_item-最低报价商品”一致，任取一个即可
> - 特殊情况：值为TRUE时表示特殊场景，需要在“航班列表”返回多报价；返回结果中“item_ist-商品列表”可能会返回两个商品，“best_price_item-最低报价商品”则为“item_ist-商品列表”中最低价商品（不建议使用）

element_fields.description_en:
The list of selected flights for the current origin-destination (OD).
> The list of selected flights for the current OD.
> - Only when searching for the return leg of a round-trip, pass the selected outbound flight in selected_flights. In all other cases, this parameter is not required.
> - For the return leg of a round-trip search, selected_flights must be taken from the results of the previous outbound search using "Flight List Search V2".
